text:
mia: Quick poll — after last week's expo, who overpacked swag vs who bought an extra bag? 🙋‍♀️
jordan: I overpacked. ended up paying $120 at CDG. :cry:
sam: Same here. Pro tip: ship an empty duffel home via DHL from the hotel — cheaper than checked bag fees sometimes.
dev-rel-anna: Or weigh swag as you pick it up. airport scales ftw. :scale:
kyle: Anyone tried the conference "hotel packing & ship" service? Heard some hotels will pack+ship for you if you leave a tag.
mia: We did that at the Berlin offsite. Hotel concierge arranged pickup next morning. Cost was ~€25 and they emailed a receipt — smooth.
lee: I made a tiny packing checklist/snippet that helped:```
- ziploc for ceramics/fragile
- roll shirts, stuff socks in shoes
- put heavy swag near wheels
- final weigh at hotel lobby scale
```
offsite-bot: Reminder: Submit shipping/extra-bag expenses to travel@redwood by Fri end-of-day.
jordan: Quick poll: would you rather 1) ship from hotel 2) pay extra checked bag 3) give away swag at the airport? react with 1/2/3
sam: :thumbsup: ship. Also happy to consolidate and mail a box from SFO if anyone is leaving items behind.
mia: Nice — consensus leaning to ship. I'll add a short "expo swag" section in the offsite doc with links to courier options and a packing checklist. Thanks!
